name: Brewer's Supplies
description:
A portable selection of measuring vessels, strainers and brewing implements supports brewing work when a suitable workspace and ingredients are supplied.

The complete set supports its own artisan-tool proficiency on appropriate checks; owning it does not grant proficiency. The GM selects the ability and resolves work, costs and completion. No crafting output or bonus is created automatically.

weight.notes: Complete tool set and case weigh 7.2 lb, 80% of the source weight. The stated custom-economy price covers the whole kit and its ordinary implements, not a workshop, raw material supply or completed job.

source.title: Devil's Table: Trade & Merchants
source.reference: SRD 5.1 p. 70: Brewer’s supplies: 20 gp; 9 lb. Original wording and custom-economy price/adjusted weight. See docs/CORE_CATALOGUE.md.
source.license: SRD 5.1 mechanics: CC-BY-4.0; original project text: distribution license pending.
